# A baseline with non-numeric metrics. awk would coerce these to 0, silently
# turning the row into a zero baseline. It does NOT then divide by it: judge()
# checks base == 0 and returns before pct() is ever called. What you get
# instead is a REGRESSION blaming a legitimate zero baseline — the right
# verdict attributed to the wrong cause — or, when the observed value is also
# 0, a silent pass. Must be a hard parse failure (exit 2), not a comparison.
